metadata.title: Celestial Cosmological Diagram with Modern Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, intricate circular diagram resembling a medieval Islamic or Persian celestial map, featuring concentric rings of zodiac figures, lunar phases, and planetary orbits, paired with a clean, modern serif wordmark in the upper-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circular geometry vs. linear typographic alignment
Aged, textured parchment tones vs. crisp digital black ink
Dense figurative illustration vs. minimalist negative space
Warm earth tones and deep lapis blue vs. stark white background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The circular diagram is centered, occupying approximately 85% of the vertical frame. The text is positioned in the top-left corner at a medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central core of the diagram, containing small figures and a pale moon-like sphere.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves to the large circular diagram, and then spirals inward through the concentric rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounds the central circle, isolating the complex graphic from the edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep lapis blue and terracotta red in the outer rings.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale parchment and gold tones for the figures and inner rings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Emerald green and black for specific orbital paths and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, historical saturation levels with high value contrast between the white background and the dark blue outer rim.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is integrated closely between words, acting as a visual bridge.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern high-contrast serif paired with hand-drawn historical manuscript art.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and vertical stress of the reference.
Provides a classic, academic feel that complements the historical subject.
Offers the sharp, elegant serifs seen in the 'c' and 'e' characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution, centered circular celestial diagram in the style of a 15th-century Persian manuscript. Use concentric rings featuring zodiac symbols, lunar phases, and planetary orbits. The palette should include lapis blue, terracotta, and gold on a clean white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the text in the top-left corner using a modern, high-contrast serif font in all lowercase. Ensure the tracking is tight and the color is solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the diagram perfectly circular and centered?
Is the text in the top-left corner in lowercase serif?
Are the colors of the diagram muted and historical?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific 'cause&effect' text; use generic placeholder text if needed.
Do not replicate specific historical signatures or calligraphic text within the diagram.

mustAchieve: Clean separation between text and image
Authentic-looking manuscript textures within the circle
Precise geometric alignment of the rings
avoid: Neon or overly vibrant modern colors

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic contrast against the white background.
Ensure the zodiac figures are distinct and not muddy.
Verify the concentric rings are perfectly round.
Confirm the ampersand style matches the serif font.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Historical Scientific Diagram] with [Modern Minimalist Typography] using [Concentric Composition] and [High-Contrast Serif] in [Top-Left Alignment].
